ground:
Create a single landscape 3:2 GROUND-ONLY background texture for a playable hand-painted woodland homestead game. Match the reference's gouache medium, low moss and fern green palette and soft sunlit grassy surface. This is specifically the empty underlying terrain onto which independent buildings, paths, trees and plants will be drawn by the game.
Fill the entire rectangular image with calm connected flat grassy meadow seen strictly vertically from above. No horizon. Broad quiet pools of desaturated light green and muted olive grass, very subtle tonal variation, a few delicate tiny brushed grass marks and sparse pale flecks. Soft diffuse sunlight from upper left. Make 90% of the surface visually quiet so independent game objects remain easy to read. Edges are the SAME brightness and color family as the middle, without vignette or border. No distinct focal point, no big feature. No deep shadow silhouettes from absent trees.
ABSOLUTELY NO trees, bushes, flowers, rocks, structures, paths, pavement, water, animals, characters, UI, letters, labels, grid or islands. No repeated V-shape pattern and no checkerboard. Matte painterly texture rather than photographic grass. Usable all the way to all four edges. This is a flat environmental texture, not a landscape painting with depth or distant objects.
paths:
Create ONE landscape 3:2 raster MATERIAL TEXTURE ATLAS for a hand-painted cozy woodland game. It contains EXACTLY six SQUARE texture tiles in THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, touching edge-to-edge with no spacing, NO captions, NO grid lines, NO borders. Each tile fills its full cell with ONLY the specified material. Tile boundaries at x=one-third/two-thirds and y=one-half. Top-down flat surfaces, no perspective or depth cutaway. Same refined matte gouache brush treatment as the reference, low-contrast painterly shading and natural material detail. NOT scene illustrations. Every tile's left and right edges and top and bottom edges must match in overall tone so it can repeat naturally. Moderate small details, seven or eight major elements across a tile, not dozens of noisy tiny marks. NO grass borders, NO plants, NO objects, NO UI.
Exact left-to-right top-to-bottom order:
1 warm cream limestone path paving, rounded irregular flat stones with narrow earthy joins, soft brush edges and worn highlights.
2 muted gray-green mossy stone paving, large flat stones with deep moss in joins, soft natural shapes.
3 honey wood boardwalk planks across the tile, subtle broad woodgrain, narrow dark gaps, no rails or posts.
4 pale warm ivory sand with extremely subtle fine grain and a few tiny pale pebbles, quiet smooth color.
5 ochre and russet fallen leaves scattered over warm earth, clear few broad leaf shapes, moss brown restrained base.
6 muted deep slate-teal magical sand with just a few tiny warm cream glimmering star-shaped grains, calm painterly sparkle and no neon.
Reference is for color and paint style only. Absolutely no transparent background; all six surfaces fully opaque and edge-to-edge.
